title: HtmlHgroup
responsibility: Renders the native hgroup element without extra wrapper DOM or feature behavior.

inputs.name: HtmlHgroup.attributes
inputs.description: Native hgroup attributes and event handlers. The native atom call preserves Svelte bindings, actions and scoped styles.

inputs.name: HtmlHgroup.children
inputs.description: Optional content within the native hgroup element; native HTML content rules still apply.

outputs.name: HtmlHgroup
outputs.description: The actual native hgroup element, with forwarded attributes and content and no additional wrapper.
